content: TSDuck's tsp (Transport Stream Processor) is a linear pipeline of input-plugin -> N processor-plugins -> output-plugin, each stage handling one TS packet at a time, no full-file random access needed for most plugins; PSI/SI tables are extracted/tracked by dedicated processor plugins (like a 'header scan' running continuously rather than as a separate first pass). This is a streaming-pipeline pattern, distinct from mediadiff's discrete pass model, but confirms that separating 'structural/table extraction' from 'payload analysis' is a recognized decomposition in transport-stream tooling.
